question: Exact installed OS/firmware build
verification_method: Read Settings > Version and capture a photo/screenshot; optionally capture Universal Device Inquiry response.
reason: Release must record exact tested build, not merely feature-set 2.1.

question: CC pair encoding for all 0-255 parameters
verification_method: Capture both CC messages while moving one paired control through carefully chosen raw values: minimum, 1, 2, 63, 64, 127, 128, 129, 254, maximum.
reason: Do not assume standard 14-bit MSB/LSB; official Peak docs only state two CCs and 0-255.

question: Peak NRPN send sequence and value width
verification_method: Capture a panel-generated NRPN and test candidate CC99, CC98, CC6 sequence, with and without CC38 and null termination.
reason: MIDI defines the building blocks, but Peak-specific sequence/tolerance needs confirmation.

question: Edit-buffer dump request and response framing
verification_method: Capture Current backup; test candidate request only in read-only protocol lab.
reason: Required for reliable initial synchronization and librarian.

question: Stored-program dump request and response framing
verification_method: Capture one selected stored patch and compare with Current dump.
reason: Required before bank librarian or memory writes.

question: SysEx payload size, checksum and validation rules
verification_method: Capture repeated identical dumps and altered copies; identify fixed/variable regions and any checksum.
reason: No decoder/encoder or write path until resolved.

question: Hardware memory write command and acknowledgement
verification_method: Obtain only after backups and a sacrificial location are prepared.
reason: Most destructive operation; must remain disabled until verified.

question: Bank Select MSB/LSB values and Program Change order
verification_method: Capture Peak transmission while changing A001, A128, B001, C001, D001 with Bank/Patch set to Transmit or Rec+Tran.
reason: Do not infer bank numbering from generic MIDI alone.

question: Universal Device Inquiry identity bytes
verification_method: Send official Universal Device Inquiry and capture response.
reason: Reverse-engineered candidate exists but is not official documentation.

question: Patch name offset, encoding and valid characters
verification_method: Compare dumps after changing only patch name, including spaces and supported punctuation.
reason: Needed for safe rename and display.

question: Patch Category and Genre label-to-code maps
verification_method: Cycle menu values and capture NRPN/dumps.
reason: Official table provides only numeric ranges, not labels.

question: Firmware 2.1 main Mod Matrix source codes
verification_method: Cycle one slot Source A through every label while logging NRPN.
reason: Current label list has 25 entries but the MIDI table still says 0-16.

question: Firmware 2.1 main Mod Matrix destination codes
verification_method: Cycle one slot destination through every label while logging NRPN.
reason: Current label list is larger than the stale 0-36 table.

question: FX Mod Matrix slot parameter numbers and enum codes
verification_method: Cycle all four slots through source/destination/depth while logging.
reason: The current appendix lists labels but not an updated numeric MIDI map.

question: Chord 2 numeric code
verification_method: Cycle Arp Type and capture value.
reason: The old range 0-6 cannot represent eight listed modes without clarification.

question: Arp Chance actual minimum and raw handling
verification_method: Test 0, 1, 9, 10 and 100 via NRPN 25:33 and panel.
reason: Official sources conflict among 0-100, 1-100 and 10-100.

question: Pan raw-to-display transform and startup default
verification_method: Test NRPN 0:51 raw values 0, 63, 64, 127 and inspect display.
reason: Feature text displays -64..+63, while MIDI table says raw 0-127/default 0.

question: Chorus mode code labels
verification_method: Test NRPN 0:115 values 0,1,2 and inspect display/audio.
reason: Official table and prose disagree on naming.

question: Boolean transmission convention
verification_method: Capture KeySync and Animate Hold values.
reason: 1.2 PDF says 0-1 while current online table says 0-127.

question: Envelope Delay NRPN parameter numbers
verification_method: Capture Amp, Mod Env 1 and Mod Env 2 Delay changes.
reason: Feature is official but 2.1 addendum does not list mappings.

question: Envelope Hold, Repeats and MonoTrig mappings
verification_method: Capture menu changes.
reason: Important patch parameters are not present in the base MIDI table.

question: LFO 3/4 base Wave, Rate and Rate Sync mappings
verification_method: Capture menu changes.
reason: 2.1 table only documents Phase, Slew and FadeTime.

question: Delay Mode, Output and Ratio mappings
verification_method: Capture menu changes.
reason: Official feature labels exist; mappings are not in the addendum table.

question: Settings dump structure
verification_method: Capture Settings backup twice and after one global setting change.
reason: Global settings must be isolated from PatchState.

question: Tuning table dump/update protocol
verification_method: Capture Settings before/after one tuning-table edit.
reason: Selected tuning table is patch-level; table contents are global.

question: Wavetable name-to-index map and any user-wave support
verification_method: Cycle WaveMore and compare panel logs/dumps.
reason: The guide lists 60 factory wavetables, while the exact encoded ordering should be captured.

question: Safe output pacing over USB and DIN
verification_method: Run ramp tests with increasing message rates and confirm no skipped/garbled values.
reason: Scheduler defaults should be evidence-based.

question: USB versus DIN response equivalence
verification_method: Repeat representative tests on USB and DIN.
reason: USB is primary; DIN support must not be assumed identical without testing.

question: Port hot-plug naming and reconnection behavior on macOS/Windows
verification_method: Power-cycle and reconnect through direct USB ports on both platforms.
reason: Required for reliable UX and to avoid connecting to wrong devices.
